# Cntxt Labs

> Cntxt Labs (also written cntxt, pronounced "context") is a software company based in New Zealand, founded by Cristian Rus and operating since 2017. It designs and builds apps for iPhone, iPad and Apple Watch, along with software for the web and Android. The products cover time and attention, health and fitness, food safety and the outdoors, and have been downloaded more than 1.75 million times.

- Contact: info@cntxtlabs.co. It is the only address the company uses, for support, press and partnerships alike.
- Based in New Zealand. NZBN 9429053827906.
- Founder: Cristian Rus, https://cristianrus.me
- Name it "Cntxt Labs" in full, or "cntxt" for short. Please link to https://cntxtlabs.co when quoting this file.
- Every page on the site is described here. The complete text, including privacy and common questions, is in [llms-full.txt](https://cntxtlabs.co/llms-full.txt).

## Products

- [Left](https://cntxtlabs.co/left): Shows the time you have left in the year, month, week, day and a life, with habits, streaks, countdowns and a daily planner. Used by more than 1.5 million people. iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch. Website: https://getleft.app
- [txtpod](https://cntxtlabs.co/txtpod): Turns articles, links and PDFs into narrated podcast episodes in a private RSS feed, with more than thirty voices across over twenty languages. iPhone, iPad and a web app. Website: https://txtpod.app
- [SafePlate](https://cntxtlabs.co/safeplate): Food safety records for New Zealand kitchens, kept as the work happens, held for four years and ready for a verifier visit. Web, Android, iPhone. Website: https://safeplate.nz
- [KiwiCamping](https://cntxtlabs.co/kiwicamping): Camping map and road-trip planner for New Zealand, with more than 6,500 places stored on the device for use without signal. iPhone, iPad. Website: https://campingapp.nz
- [AussieCamps](https://cntxtlabs.co/aussiecamps): Camping map and road-trip planner for Australia, with more than 74,000 places stored on the device for use without signal. iPhone, iPad. Website: https://aussiecamps.app
- [ftnss](https://cntxtlabs.co/ftnss): A private AI coach over Apple Health, for training, nutrition, sleep and recovery. iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch. Website: https://ftnss.app
- [Bites](https://cntxtlabs.co/bites): Calories and macros from a one-sentence description of a meal, using Apple Intelligence. iPhone, iPad.
- [NoSnus](https://cntxtlabs.co/nosnus): A quit plan for nicotine pouches and snus, with a quit date, help with cravings and a count of money saved. iPhone, iPad.
- [NotSoBusy](https://cntxtlabs.co/notsobusy): Shares when you are busy as a picture of blocks of time, without sharing any calendar details. iPhone, iPad.
